_meta.purpose: Pre-resolved registry values for downstream agents. Agents consuming this file do NOT need to load raw registry files.

spec_identity.notes: Fourth interior RP spec (after SF_DRYWALL_WALL_INT_RP, SF_DRYWALL_CEILING_INT_RP, SF_TRIM_INT_RP). Combined prime + finish for interior door frame + slab. Context prefix DIRP (Door Interior RePaint) confirmed — no collision with existing prefixes. TSK_DOOR_* is NC door slab; TSK_FRAME_* is NC door frame; TSK_DRRP_* is exterior door RP (51 tasks). DIRP avoids all collisions. Verified: zero TSK_DIRP_* IDs exist in id_registry.json context_prefixes_in_use.

paintable_items.name: Door frame set (jamb + stop)
paintable_items.notes: Reuse existing item from SF_DOOR_FRAME_NC_FINISH. Same physical item in RP context. No phase suffix needed — this is the frame assembly. One frame set = head jamb + 2 side jambs + door stop.

paintable_items.name: Door slab side (repaint)
paintable_items.notes: NC uses separate ITM_ IDs with no RP equivalent at EA_SIDE granularity. NC door slab spec (SF_DOOR_SLAB_INT_NC) does not register an EA_SIDE item in id_registry — tasks reference EA_SIDE directly. Proposing ITM_DOOR_SLAB_RP to formalize the EA_SIDE door slab item for the combined RP spec. Includes edge assigned to that face per Doors_Doctrine Section 10.3.

task_prefix.collision_check: No collision. TSK_DOOR_* is NC door slab (SF_DOOR_SLAB_INT_NC). TSK_FRAME_* is NC door frame (SF_DOOR_FRAME_NC_FINISH). TSK_DRRP_* is exterior door RP (SF_DOOR_EXT_RP_v1, 51 tasks). TSK_WLRP_* is wall RP. TSK_CLRP_* is ceiling RP. TSK_TMRP_* is trim RP. TSK_DIRP_* is unique for interior door RP. Checked against id_registry.json context_prefixes_in_use — DIRP not present.
task_prefix.naming_rule: TSK_DIRP_{ACTION} — action should be verb-based (ASSESS_CONDITION, ASSESS_ADHESION, ASSESS_COATING_ID, ASSESS_MOISTURE, DEGLOSS_FRAME, DEGLOSS_SLAB, SCRAPE_FEATHER, WASH_TSP, PRIME_ADHESION_BRUSH, FINISH_BRUSH_1, etc.). ALL tasks in this combined RP spec use the DIRP_ prefix — both RP-new tasks and tasks adapted from NC frame/slab specs. Direct NC task transfers are re-issued under TSK_DIRP_* for prefix consistency.

expected_modules.notes: Floor protection (perimeter brush / 8ft radius spray), wall masking (spray only), hardware handling (remove for spray / mask for brush), furniture clear if occupied. Method-dependent protection scope.

RP-specific: condition scan per opening, adhesion test (ASTM D3359), coating ID (latex vs alkyd solvent test), moisture check on frame bottoms (bathroom/kitchen). Assessment maps to 'prep' phase — no 'assessment' phase value exists in controlled_enums. FIXED time tasks.

TSP wash, degloss (frame EA + slab EA_SIDE), scrape/feather (FAIR/POOR condition), fill/patch damaged areas, caulk assess/replace (partial, not full re-caulk), mildew treatment (moisture damage), dust removal. Dual-UOM tasks: frame tasks in EA, slab tasks in EA_SIDE.

State-driven primer: SYS_PRIMER_ADHESION_INT (alkyd existing or adhesion failure), SYS_PRIMER_STAINBLOCK_INT (smoke/nicotine damage — shellac BIN), SYS_PRIMER_MILDEW_INT (moisture damage with mildew history). Conditional on substrate_state. Brush/spray variants for each. No primer for SS_INT_SOUND_PAINT with good adhesion test + latex existing.

Fine-finish interstage protocol at all tiers: inspect coat, light sand between coats (QT3 spot 220, QT4 full 220, QT5 thorough 320), patch/repair defects, clean dust. Runs between each coat pair. Universal for doors — scrutinized surface.

Finish coat application — brush or spray. Frame tasks (EA) + slab tasks (EA_SIDE). 2 coats standard (QT3-QT4), 3 coats QT5 brush per FFD 15.10.3. Interstage between coats. Fine-finish coating systems: SYS_FF_STANDARD_ACRYLIC (QT3), SYS_FF_MODIFIED_URETHANE (QT4), SYS_FF_PREMIUM (QT5).
Protection teardown, hardware reinstall (spray) / unmask (brush), door rehang if removed, floor protection removal, customer walkthrough (RP-specific), tool clean, final inspection.

Shared lead-safe RRP module. Conditional on PS_META.BOOL.HOME_PRE_1978. Shared across all interior RP specs. Pre-existing shared module — not owned by this spec. Doors are HIGH RISK for lead paint — trim/doors were last surfaces to transition from oil to latex.

paintscope_keys.description: Count of door frame sets to be repainted. One frame set = head jamb + 2 side jambs + door stop.
Count of door slab sides to be repainted. Supports different-color-per-side and partial-painting scenarios.
Total door openings in scope. Drives per-opening tasks: protection setup/teardown, hardware handling, assessment.
Count of flush/slab door sides for complexity modifier (1.0x).
paintscope_keys.notes: Door type breakdown by side count for weighted complexity. New PS key for RP door type distribution.

paintscope_keys.description: Count of panel door sides (4-panel, 6-panel, raised) for complexity modifier (1.25-1.4x).
paintscope_keys.notes: Most common residential door type. Panel_6 (colonial) is default.

paintscope_keys.description: Count of French door sides for complexity modifier (2.0x) and glass masking tasks.
paintscope_keys.notes: French doors require glass masking — adds 80-120% labor.

paintscope_keys.description: Count of bifold door panel sides for complexity modifier (0.7x).
Count of louvered door sides for complexity modifier (2.5x). Spray-only for RP.
Total glass panes across all French doors. Drives glass masking/unmasking tasks.
Floor protection area for brush method drip containment.
Radial floor protection for spray method overspray containment.
Wall masking LF around door openings for spray method.
Hardware group count for masking/removal tasks (hinges + lockset + strike per door).
Height classification for frame tasks. Most interior doors are H1 (standard) or H2 (tall 7-8 ft).
Surface condition enum (GOOD/FAIR/POOR) for condition modifier selection. Values from condition_scale enum.
paintscope_keys.notes: Shared with SF_DRYWALL_WALL_INT_RP (proposed there first). RP-specific condition assessment driving prep intensity.

paintscope_keys.description: Interior substrate state classification (SS_INT_SOUND_PAINT through SS_INT_SMOKE_DAMAGE). Drives primer selection logic.
paintscope_keys.notes: Shared with SF_DRYWALL_WALL_INT_RP (proposed there first). Distinct from SURFACE_CONDITION which drives prep intensity.

paintscope_keys.description: Boolean flag indicating home built before 1978, triggering RRP lead-safe module.
paintscope_keys.notes: Shared with SF_DRYWALL_WALL_INT_RP (proposed there first). Doors are HIGH RISK for lead paint.

paintscope_keys.description: Contamination type: none, mildew, smoke, water_stain. Drives primer selection and treatment task activation.
Room count — drives per-room heuristics (customer walkthrough, fixed-time tasks).

quality_tier.notes: QT2 excluded per Doors_Doctrine — doors are scrutinized surfaces requiring minimum QT3. QT modifiers for doors are HIGHER than global: QT3=1.0x, QT4=1.4x, QT5=1.8x (vs global 1.3x/1.5x).

application_method.notes: Brush is default for RP (occupied home, fewer doors). Spray for production work (10+ doors). Roll is NOT valid for doors. spray_backroll not applicable. Louvered doors are spray-only.

sheen.notes: Semi-gloss is traditional/default door sheen. Satin acceptable at QT3. Gloss at QT5 only. Flat/matte/eggshell NOT valid for doors per Fine_Finish_Doctrine.

phase.notes: Assessment tasks map to 'prep' phase — no 'assessment' phase value exists in controlled_enums. 'apply' omitted from values because spec uses prime/finish directly.

unit_of_measure.notes: EA for frame tasks and per-opening tasks. EA_SIDE for slab tasks. LF for wall masking. SF for floor protection. EA_ROOM for per-room heuristics. FIXED for assessment and customer walkthrough.

substrate_state.notes: All 5 interior RP substrate states accepted. Output normalizes to standard SS_PAINTED_* per selected sheen. Semi-gloss is default door sheen. Frame and slab may have different substrate states (e.g., bathroom door frame bottom = moisture damage, slab = sound paint).

condition_scale.notes: Universal 3-level condition scale per controlled_enums.json. Drives prep pool modifier: GOOD=1.0x, FAIR=1.5x, POOR=2.0x.

consumable_category.notes: All categories valid for door RP. 'tool' covers contour scrapers, assessment kit. 'prep' covers TSP solution, deglosser.

product_role.notes: Primer = state-driven RP primers. Finish = fine-finish QT-driven systems. Specialty = shellac stain blocker, biocide.

yield_uom.notes: EA for per-door consumables. EA_SIDE for per-side consumables. SF for coverage-based consumables. GAL for product yield.

protection_level.notes: edge_only for floor_perimeter (brush). full_cover for floor_full_8ft_radius (spray) and wall_adjacent_door (spray). item_mask for hardware_covers (brush). light_mask for casing junction (different finish group).

frame_type.notes: Frame type modifier: standard=1.0x, pocket=0.85x, cased_opening=0.75x, bifold=0.90x. Transfers from NC unchanged.

floor_type.notes: RP ALWAYS has finished floors. Subfloor and partial not applicable to interior RP.

modifier_mechanism.notes: QT3=baseline (1.0x), QT4=selective_multiplier (1.4x on qt_scaled tasks — door-specific higher modifier), QT5=selective_multiplier (1.8x) + additional_rounds (coat 3 brush per FFD 15.10.3).

surface_ids.primary_surface_note: door_frame is representative for frame component. door_leaf_face is primary for slab component. Both are existing surface IDs.
surface_ids.notes: All surface IDs are existing in id_registry.json surface_ids entries_in_active_use. door_frame: frame set. door_leaf_face: slab faces. door_casing: trim (covered by SF_TRIM_INT_RP). wall_field: walls adjacent to door opening. door_leaf_edge: slab edges. door_stop: stop molding (bundled with frame set).

zone_ids.notes: Drop cloth at door location for brush method drip containment. Always required.
Rosin paper 8ft radius around door opening for spray overspray containment. Spray method only.
Wall masking around door opening for spray method. Protection level escalates from none (unfinished wall) to full_mask (finished wall) per state_declarations.
Brush: mask 3 hinges + lockset + strike plate. Spray: remove all hardware, bag and label, reinstall after cure. Method-dependent.
Door swing arc protection. Typically subsumed by floor_full_8ft_radius for spray. May be separate for touch-up work.
Glass pane masking for French doors. Conditional on door_type = french.

material_system_prefix.notes: All 6 material systems are existing/shared. Three RP primer systems (adhesion, stain-block, mildew) are shared with wall RP and other interior RP specs (proposed in SF_DRYWALL_WALL_INT_RP resolution). Three fine-finish systems (QT3/QT4/QT5) are shared with NC door frame, NC door slab, NC trim, and all other fine-finish specs. SYS_FF_GALLERY (QT5 architect-spec) available but typically overkill for RP doors — Materials Manager may include as optional. No new material systems needed for this spec.

shared_rp_consumables.name: Liquid Sander / Deglosser
shared_rp_consumables.notes: RP-specific. Proposed in SF_TRIM_INT_RP resolution. Chemical degloss for existing paint. Shared across interior RP specs.

shared_rp_consumables.name: RP Assessment Kit (Adhesion + Coating ID)
shared_rp_consumables.notes: RP-specific. Proposed in SF_TRIM_INT_RP resolution. Cross-hatch cutter, tape (ASTM D3359), mineral spirits, white rags. Shared across interior RP specs.

proposed_consumables.name: TSP (Trisodium Phosphate) Cleaner
proposed_consumables.justification: RP door-specific decontamination wash. Removes hand oils, cleaning chemical residue, surface contaminants before painting. Not used in NC (new substrate is clean). May also be useful for trim RP but first formalized here.

proposed_consumables.name: Wood Hardener / Consolidant
proposed_consumables.justification: For moisture-damaged frame bottoms where wood substrate is softened. Penetrating consolidant stabilizes wood fibers before filling/priming. Conditional on SS_INT_MOISTURE_DAMAGE + soft substrate finding. Not used in NC (no moisture-damaged substrate).

proposed_rounds.description: State-driven prime + 2 finish coats. Standard RP sequence for FAIR/POOR condition doors requiring primer.
proposed_rounds.notes: Most common RP round for doors with adhesion or contamination issues. Prime coat is state-driven (adhesion, stain-block, or mildew primer). Both frame and slab follow same round.

proposed_rounds.description: 2 finish coats only. GOOD condition, no prime needed — sound paint with adhesion verified.
proposed_rounds.notes: Skip prime when adhesion test passes, existing paint is sound, and coating is compatible (latex over latex). Most common residential repaint scenario.

proposed_rounds.description: Prime + 3 finish coats. QT5 + brush per FFD 15.10.3 + FAIR/POOR condition.
proposed_rounds.notes: Maximum coat sequence for doors. State-driven prime + 3 brush finish coats with thorough interstage at 320 grit.

proposed_rounds.description: 3 finish coats. QT5 + brush + GOOD condition.
proposed_rounds.notes: QT5 brush adds 3rd finish coat per FFD 15.10.3 even without prime.

proposed_profiles.description: Coverage rate for adhesion primer on previously painted door surfaces. Different absorption than bare-wood primer.
proposed_profiles.notes: Previously painted surfaces absorb less primer than bare wood. Expect 400-500 SF-equivalent/gal for frames, ~12-15 EA_SIDE/gal for slabs.

proposed_profiles.description: Coverage rate for shellac stain blocker on smoke-damaged door surfaces.
proposed_profiles.notes: Shellac primers have lower coverage than latex. Expect 250-350 SF-equivalent/gal.

proposed_profiles.description: Coverage rate for fine-finish enamel on repainted door surfaces.
proposed_profiles.notes: Similar to NC fine-finish coverage but slightly better absorption on previously painted substrate. COV_FRAME_FINISH may be reusable — Materials Manager to evaluate.

existing_modifiers_to_reuse.notes: Shared per instruction. Drives prep pool: GOOD=1.0x, FAIR=1.5x, POOR=2.0x.
Shared per instruction. Drives treatment task activation and primer selection.

existing_modifiers_from_nc.notes: Transfers from NC unchanged. Flush=1.0x, panel_4=1.25x, panel_6=1.35x, raised_panel=1.4x, french=2.0x, bifold=0.7x, louvered=2.5x. Applied per EA_SIDE for slab tasks.
Transfers from NC unchanged. Standard=1.0x, pocket=0.85x, cased_opening=0.75x, bifold=0.90x. Applied per EA for frame tasks.
Transfers from NC. H1=1.0x (standard 6'8"-7'), H2=1.30x (tall 7'-8'), H3=1.50x (rare interior). Applies to frame tasks only — slabs painted at ground level.

prep_pool.flag_note: Exceeds 4.0x flag. However, louvered + POOR + H2 is an extremely rare combination. More realistic max: POOR(2.0) x raised_panel(1.4) x H2(1.30) = 3.64x. Flag for estimator review if louvered + POOR.

coating_pool.flag_note: Exceeds 4.0x. Louvered + QT5 is unlikely (louvered doors rarely get QT5 treatment). Realistic max: QT5(1.8) x raised_panel(1.4) x H2(1.30) = 3.28x.

coordination_notes: Door RP runs alongside trim RP (SF_TRIM_INT_RP) which covers door casing. Sequencing: trim first, then doors (trim masking protects finished casing during door spray). Or same session if same color.
Door RP may run alongside wall RP (SF_DRYWALL_WALL_INT_RP) in full interior repaint. Sequencing: doors/trim first, then walls per A-005 rule (80% default: trim/doors before walls).
Wall masking for door spray (wall_adjacent_door zone) may be already in place from wall RP spray setup — coordination avoids duplicate protection setup.
MOD_RRP_INT_CONTAINMENT is shared across all interior RP specs — do not duplicate lead-safe tasks.
Door casing adjacency with SF_TRIM_INT_RP — when both specs active, casing-to-frame tape line is needed only when different finish group.

cross_file_threading: RULE 1: Every TSK_ in sop_modules.json MUST have a matching rate in production.json
RULE 2: Every ITM_ in spec.json MUST appear in at least one variant
RULE 3: Every SYS_ quality_tier MUST match spec.json configuration_dimensions
RULE 4: Every IN_ input in spec.json SHOULD be consumed by sop_modules or production
RULE 5: Every PS_ key in production.json MUST match spec.json required_paintscope_inputs
RULE 6: Every zone_id in spec.json MUST match sop_modules.json protection_metadata.zones
RULE 7: Module phase order: setup -> prep -> prime -> apply -> interstage -> finish -> cleanup
RULE 8: UOM for a task MUST match between sop_modules.json and production.json
RULE 9: Every TSK_ context prefix from resolution.json MUST be used in sop_modules.json and production.json
RULE 10: Every ITM_ marked 'existing' in resolution.json MUST use the exact registered ID
RULE 11: Downstream agents MUST use only enum values from resolution.json applicable_enums

registry_additions_proposed.name: Interior Door Repaint (Combined Frame + Slab, Prime + Finish)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New spec family for interior door repaint. Covers frame (EA) + slab (EA_SIDE) combined. No existing SF_ covers interior door RP.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Door slab side (repaint)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: EA_SIDE door slab item for combined RP spec. NC does not register an EA_SIDE item in id_registry. ITM_DOOR_FRAME_SET is reused; slab needs a formalized item. _RP suffix distinguishes from any future NC slab item.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Interior Door Repaint Task Prefix
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New context prefix DIRP for interior door RP tasks (~42 tasks). Avoids collision with TSK_DOOR_* (NC slab), TSK_FRAME_* (NC frame), TSK_DRRP_* (exterior door RP, 51 tasks), TSK_WLRP_* (wall RP), TSK_CLRP_* (ceiling RP), TSK_TMRP_* (trim RP).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Interior Door Repaint Module Prefix
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New module prefix for 7 DIRP modules (setup, assessment, prep, prime, interstage, finish, cleanup) + shared MOD_RRP_INT_CONTAINMENT.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Door RP: State-Driven Prime + 2 Finish Coats
registry_additions_proposed.justification: RP-specific round with conditional state-driven prime. Not equivalent to existing ROUND_DOOR_PRIME_FINISH_2COAT (NC, substrate-driven prime).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Door RP: 2 Finish Coats (No Prime)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: RP GOOD condition round — skip prime when adhesion verified. Distinct from ROUND_DOOR_FINISH_2COAT because RP context has different preconditions.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Door RP: Prime + 3 Finish Coats (QT5 Brush)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Maximum coat sequence for QT5 brush per FFD 15.10.3 + FAIR/POOR condition.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Door RP: 3 Finish Coats (QT5 Brush, No Prime)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: QT5 brush 3-coat sequence for GOOD condition. No prime needed.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Adhesion Primer Coverage on Painted Door Surfaces
registry_additions_proposed.justification: RP-specific coverage rate — adhesion primer on previously painted doors differs from bare-wood primer coverage.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Shellac Stain Blocker Coverage on Door Surfaces
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Shellac primers have distinct coverage rate from latex/adhesion primers.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Fine-Finish Enamel Coverage on Repainted Door Surfaces
registry_additions_proposed.justification: RP-specific finish coverage — slightly different absorption on previously painted substrate vs bare. Materials Manager to evaluate if COV_FRAME_FINISH can be reused.

registry_additions_proposed.name: TSP (Trisodium Phosphate) Cleaner
registry_additions_proposed.justification: RP-specific surface decontamination wash for doors. Removes hand oils, cleaning residue, grease. Not used in NC.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Wood Hardener / Consolidant
registry_additions_proposed.justification: For moisture-damaged frame bottoms. Stabilizes softened wood fibers before filling/priming. Conditional on SS_INT_MOISTURE_DAMAGE + soft substrate. Not used in NC.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Flush/Slab Door Side Count
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Door type distribution key for complexity modifier. New PS key for RP door type breakdown.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Panel Door Side Count
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Door type distribution key for complexity modifier (1.25-1.4x).

registry_additions_proposed.name: French Door Side Count
registry_additions_proposed.justification: French door distribution key for complexity modifier (2.0x) and glass masking task activation.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Bifold Door Side Count
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Bifold door distribution key for complexity modifier (0.7x).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Louvered Door Side Count
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Louvered door distribution key for complexity modifier (2.5x) and spray-only constraint.

registry_additions_proposed.justification: Input mapping for PS_META.EA_SIDE.DOOR_SLAB.SLAB.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Panel Door Side Count Input
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Input mapping for PS_META.EA_SIDE.DOOR_SLAB.PANEL.

registry_additions_proposed.justification: Input mapping for PS_META.EA_SIDE.DOOR_SLAB.FRENCH.

registry_additions_proposed.justification: Input mapping for PS_META.EA_SIDE.DOOR_SLAB.BIFOLD.
